title: Elf Bar 600 Kiwi Passionfruit Guava Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: Designed for use with the Elf Bar 600 Prefilled Pod Kit, these Elf Bar 600 Prefilled Pods provide a simple and cost-effective way to enjoy some of Elf Bar’s most popular flavours. Each 2ml prefilled pod delivers up to 600 puffs, depending on individual usage, and contains 20mg nic salt e-liquid for a smooth, satisfying mouth-to-lung (MTL) draw and rapid nicotine relief. Kiwi Passion Fruit Guava Flavour: A lively tropical blend bursting with exotic fruit notes. Tangy passion fruit and tart kiwi add a bright, refreshing kick, while smooth guava rounds out the flavour with its naturally sweet and mellow finish. Swapping pods is quick and hassle-free—just click a fresh one into place and vape. Whether you're switching from disposables or looking for a more practical way to enjoy Elf Bar’s premium flavours, these prefilled pods offer convenience without compromise.
